entities.name: Horrors
entities.description: A catch-all creature type for horrible, black-aligned fiends that defy normal description, arising from nightmares, experiments and hellish planes.

entities.name: Cellarspawn
entities.description: Duskmourn horrors that are manifestations of Valgavoth's daydreams and reduce victims to spindrells.

entities.name: Valgavoth
entities.description: The demon of Duskmourn whose daydreams manifest as cellarspawn.

entities.name: Mage Hunter
entities.description: A horror from Galathul that senses magic and was one of the Oriq's most powerful tools.

entities.name: Oriq
entities.description: A group on Arcavios that used Mage Hunters, defeated at Strixhaven.

entities.name: Geyadrone Dihada
entities.description: A dark planeswalker who summoned a Cosmic Horror to sack Sedouris.

entities.name: Sol'Kanar the Swamp King
entities.description: A ruler who held the city of Sedouris under siege for five years.

entities.name: Shauku
entities.description: A figure who trapped a Cosmic Horror in her underground lair.

entities.name: Chainer
entities.description: A dementia caster of the Cabal who summons horrors from his dementia space.

entities.name: Dauthi
entities.description: People of Rath trapped in the Shadows whose sanity broke and some of whom manifested as horrors.

entities.name: Tsabo Tavoc
entities.description: A Phyrexian who led the Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria at Urborg with horrors.

entities.name: Morinfen
entities.description: A Phyrexian horror, one of the first to emerge at Urborg.

entities.name: Gallowbraid
entities.description: A Phyrexian horror, brother of Morinfen.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan whose corruption created horrors on Innistrad.

entities.name: Greel, Mind Raker
entities.description: A strange demon controlled by the Keldons during their invasion of Jamuraa.

entities.name: Duskmourn
entities.description: The plane of the House where cellarspawn dwell.

events.summary: Geyadrone Dihada summons a powerful Cosmic Horror to sack Sedouris after Sol'Kanar's five-year siege.
events.quote: to sack the city of Sedouris on Corondor after Sol'Kanar the Swamp King had held the city under siege for five years.

events.summary: A Cosmic Horror trapped by Shauku summons a Falling Star and destroys her lair.
events.quote: The captive Horror summoned a Falling Star and destroyed Shauku's lair.

events.summary: The Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria is led at Urborg by Tsabo Tavoc and accompanying horrors.
events.quote: the Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria was led by Tsabo Tavoc and accompanying horrors.

events.summary: Phyrexian horrors first reveal themselves anew at Urborg with the brothers Morinfen and Gallowbraid.
events.quote: the first being the brothers Morinfen and Gallowbraid .

events.summary: Trapped in the Shadows, some Dauthi lose their sanity and manifest as horrors.
events.quote: This predicament led the Dauthi to lose their sanity, and some of them manifested as horrors ( Dauthi Horror ).

events.summary: Emrakul's corruption creates horrors in other colors of mana on Innistrad.
events.quote: In The Travails , as a consequence of Emrakul 's corruption, a variety of horrors have appeared in other colors of mana
